title: EUTiers Tagger
description: Mod that shows player's tiers from our site
body:
Shows player's tiers from discord and site
Commands:
/eutiers sword (switches mode to the sword and default one)
/eutiers axe (switches mode to the axe)
/eutiers pot (switches mode to the pot)
/eutiers mace (switches mode to the mace)
/eutiers uhc (switches mode to the uhc)
